Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - elevated egress failures observed in us-west-2a (AZ-a). 30% outbound error-rate to third-party APIs. Auto-escalating to on-call.

tilly_sre: Oncall here. Seeing spikes of 502/connection reset for services with subnet tag az-a-prod. Correlates with recent routing change 20m ago. Paging network.

maria_neteng: I'm looking. Quick snapshot: route table rtb-0abc has destination 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-i-PRIMARY (instance route) even though we expected natgw nat-0primary. Propagation looks incomplete after the terraform apply.

alex_eng: Can we fail over egress to the standby NAT in us-west-2b while we investigate propagation? Need to reduce customer impact.

tilly_sre: Attempting to update route table to nat-standby now. If propagation doesn't finish, we'll add explicit routes per subnet.

tilly_sre: ```
# replacing default route to standby NAT
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0standby
# verifying
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --route-table-ids rtb-0abc
```

deploy-bot: Deploy guard: network changes detected in incidents channel, blocking new deploys for 15m :no_entry_sign:.

maria_neteng: Route update accepted but AWS console shows propagation status STALE for the subnet associations. Some subnets still reference the old instance route. This looks like a propagation race from the earlier change.

alex_eng: Partial recovery visible in metrics (about 70% of traffic healthy). Jamal_CS - any customer reports?

jamal_cs: We're triaging incoming tickets. 7 new reports from high-volume customers: uploads to S3 and webhook deliveries failing. CS set incident severity to P2 and notified account teams. Collecting request ids now.

tilly_sre: As a mitigation, I've applied explicit replace-route calls against each affected route table (not relying on propagation). Doing target-by-target changes to avoid another propagation delay.

maria_neteng: I confirmed NACLs and SGs haven't changed recently. NAT primary healthchecks show intermittent 504s -> probably overloaded after the route flap. Standby NAT is healthy but subnets lagged in switching.

alex_eng: We're provisioning a fresh NAT in AZ-a and will re-associate the subnets to it to remove instance-based fallback. Starting NAT creation now.

tilly_sre: New NAT created (nat-0fed). Re-associating subnets in batches to reduce blast radius. Rolling traffic switch in progress, ETA ~3m.

Incident Bot: Update — egress error rate down to ~4% across AZs after re-assoc. Monitoring window 15m passing threshold. No new paged alerts.

jamal_cs: Notifying affected customers with status update and offering credits. Collecting affected request ids for post-incident analysis.

tilly_sre: Handoff: I'll remain monitoring for 1h and own realtime logs. @maria_neteng please own network postmortem (root cause: route propagation race + instance fallback). @alex_eng please document mitigation steps (explicit per-subnet route replace, NAT re-provision). I'll draft timeline and impact summary. :thumbsup:

tilly_sre: Initial timeline will include timestamps for terraform apply, alert spike, route replace attempts, NAT creation, and recovery. Leaving channel open for 30m for any followups.
